title: Graduated authority envelopes and the fiduciary wedge
text: The manuscript outlines graduated authority: systems earn expanded operational discretion based on demonstrated performance telemetry rather than static permission grants. Consequential and irreversible commitments (financial disbursements, legal agreements, external disclosures) remain bound by a 'fiduciary wedge' requiring accountable human sign-off, whereas routine reversible actions operate under confidence-scored exception routing.
qualification: Governance model proposal. Machine-generated confidence scores are frequently uncalibrated on out-of-distribution events, and demonstrated success on routine cases does not guarantee safety during unprecedented operational stress.
